title: Slide Decks & Design Themes
description: Learn to insert new slides, choose themes, format text frames, and arrange presentation visuals.
objectives: Navigate slide thumbnails and main slide canvas
Insert new slides with Title & Content layouts

steps.title: PowerPoint Workspace Layout
steps.content: PowerPoint features a left slide pane showing thumbnails of your deck, a central editing canvas, and a top ribbon with Design, Transitions, and Animations tabs.

steps.title: Interactive Challenge: Add a New Slide
steps.content: Click the 'New Slide' button in the ribbon to expand your presentation deck.
steps.hint: Click the + New Slide button on the PowerPoint Home ribbon tab.

quiz.question: Which view mode in PowerPoint allows you to see all slide thumbnails arranged in a grid?
quiz.explanation: Slide Sorter View shows all slides in a grid layout, making it easy to reorder deck slides.
